item.title: Nachi Fire Festival: Flaming Torches Before the Waterfall — Guide
item.description: The Nachi Fire Festival (Nachi no Ogi Matsuri), held every year on July 14th, is one of Japan’s three great fire festivals and the most dramatic event of the Kumano year. Twelve towering fan-shaped mikoshi — representing the twelve deities of Kumano Nachi Taisha and decorated with red silk fans and mirrors — are carried down to the foot of Nachi Falls, where they are met by priests in white swinging twelve enormous burning torches weighing some 50 kilos each.
